notes: Hand-curated ground truth mined from the OVOS skill fleet's own end-to-end test suites, independent of the skills' own intent templates/vocab (source_repo/source_file/intent_label_original provenance columns retained per row). expected_intent is the canonical 'skill_id:intent_name' label with the .intent suffix already stripped by the corpus builder, matching this registry's label convention (see intents-for-eval). 1,121 rows across 19 languages (en-US 683, the rest 8-34 each). No train_datasets link: this eval set has no matching template/keyword training corpus in the registry (the skill fleet's own intent files are not registered as a paradigm-specific train corpus here), so golden-utterances is scoped to the open 'intent' (fusion) league only, same v1-scoping precedent as speech-massive-*. Rows also carry needs_manual/machine_generated flags for filtering low-confidence or synthetic rows, and a required_vocab/expected_messages pair for future slot/vocab scoring, but this entry does not map a 'slots' reference field — the corpus has no slot-span gold yet, so slot_exact_match is not scoreable against golden-utterances.
